field_docs.at: ISO-8601 UTC time the row was computed
field_docs.repo: owner/repo the keys were computed for
field_docs.deploys: PRs merged to main in the window (deployment frequency)
field_docs.lead_time_h: median hours from first commit to merge
field_docs.restore_h: median hours from a revert's target merge to the revert merge
field_docs.reverts: merged PRs whose title matches the revert pattern
field_docs.held_7d: merged PRs older than 7 days with no revert against them

description: DORA four keys per repo per run (crew#495) plus task-outcome fields (crew#368): reverts = merged PRs whose title reverts a prior one, held_7d = merged PRs still open on main after 7 days with no revert.
